concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage vs plan.md:Constitution Check
concerns.text: Plan's Constitution Check claims pinned 'requirements.txt (Python) and renv.lock (R)', but no task creates, verifies, or even mentions either dependency file. T002 covers only config.yaml. The plan's Reproducibility element has no implementing task.

T005 invokes 'the existing code/R/03_fit_moderator.R', but the plan's project structure lists only code/R/01_fit_pglS.R and 02_sensitivity.R. The moderator R script is a plan element with no traceable origin; if it does not exist, T005 cannot execute as written.

T004 requires sensitivity_log.csv columns 'iteration_id, excluded_species, coefficient_telomere, se, p_value, method_justification', but the data model's SensitivityLog entity defines only iteration_id, excluded_species, coefficient_telomere, p_value. The task deliverable contradicts the read-only data contract it must satisfy.

Tasks produce data/processed/merged_data.csv, but the data model's Data Flow names processed/telomere_standardized.csv and processed/merged_analysis.csv as the intermediate/final files. Filename drift means the data-model's file elements are not covered by any task as specified.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T001 vs spec.md:US-1 Independent Test / SC-001
concerns.text: US-1's independent test sets a measurable >90% merged-species threshold for SC-001, but T001's coverage note only says to 'report matched/total species in the run log' — the threshold is never evaluated by any task's verification step.

T003 requires model_summary.csv to validate against the schema, but the FR-004 low-power path (skip the fit when n_species < 15) cannot produce the schema-required fields (fixed_effect_telomere, aic_score, n_species min 1). The low-power branch and schema-validity verification are mutually unsatisfiable as tasked.
